items.label: Self tools
items.desc: Health, core, stamina, wanted and visibility controls are grouped under Self. Gameplay behavior depends on the supported build and local player.

items.label: Movement
items.desc: Movement options include super run, super jump and swimming controls.

items.label: Walking Noclip
items.desc: Move through obstacles on foot with camera-relative left-stick input while retaining aim and fire.
settings: Movement pauses while the menu is open

items.label: Walking styles
items.desc: Choose a walking-style preset or reset the current style.

items.label: Animations & scenarios
items.desc: Browse animation, emote and scenario pages, with search and stop controls.

items.label: Appearance pages
items.desc: Browse model, outfit and component categories. Model changes remain under gameplay validation.

items.label: Outfit editor
items.desc: Choose clothing components and their available variations for the current model.

items.label: Saved outfits
items.desc: Save and load outfit files through the PS4 menu. Compatible legacy outfit files are listed separately.

items.label: Outfit presets
items.desc: Browse gender-specific outfit presets. Individual presets and model compatibility remain in testing.

items.label: Loadout
items.desc: Weapon selection and give/equip controls are organized in a dedicated loadout page.

items.label: Ammo
items.desc: Ammo options have their own page, separate from loadout and visuals.

items.label: Weapon options
items.desc: Browse weapon, clip, damage and maintenance controls for the current local player.

items.label: Weapon visuals
items.desc: Laser sight, bullet tracer and throwable tracer settings are grouped under Visuals. Individual rendering behavior is still being refined.

items.label: Crosshair
items.desc: Configure the crosshair independently from the ESP and weapon settings.

items.label: Player ESP
items.desc: Configure player labels, boxes, lines, health and distance. Skeleton and other detailed visuals remain under validation.

items.label: NPC & animal ESP
items.desc: NPCs and horses have separate visual settings, including labels and distance.

items.label: Vehicle ESP
items.desc: Vehicle visuals focus on box, line, name and distance controls.

items.label: Self ESP
items.desc: Configure local-player visuals independently of other players.

items.label: Visual style
items.desc: Adjust colors, text scale, label placement and backgrounds per category.

items.label: Players list
items.desc: Browse current session players from Network → Players.

items.label: Player tags
items.desc: Labels can identify the local player, host and friends when that information is available.

items.label: Player info
items.desc: Choose whether the selected-player information panel is shown. Portraits, IP addresses and geolocation are not available in this PS4 build.

items.label: Waypoint teleport
items.desc: Travel to the current map waypoint when a valid destination can be resolved.

items.label: Objective teleport
items.desc: Use the current supported objective destination.

items.label: Automatic waypoint & objective travel
items.desc: Automatic travel has its own toggles; the matching one-shot buttons are hidden while auto mode is enabled.

items.label: Saved locations
items.desc: Save, browse and load your own named destinations.

items.label: Destination categories
items.desc: Browse organized destination lists and closest-location controls. Live camp and Madam Nazar routing depend on additional verified game state.

items.label: World controls
items.desc: Weather, time and world settings are organized into their own pages.

items.label: Spawner categories
items.desc: Browse pedestrian, animal, horse, vehicle, object and plant pages. Availability depends on the model and current game state.

items.label: Spawn settings
items.desc: Each supported entity category has its own placement and management options.

items.label: Spawned entity management
items.desc: Manage tracked spawned entities. Treasure lifetime and visibility to other players remain under testing; full synchronization is not promised.

items.label: Money & Gold requests
items.desc: Individual requests, loop toggles, batch size and local delay controls. Game eligibility and reward processing determine payouts; a locally accepted request does not confirm a reward.

items.label: Inventory collection sets
items.desc: Collections live under Recovery → XP. Inventory-based sets have give and loop controls; Fossils, Eggs and All Collections require a Loot route that is not available in this PS4 build.

items.label: Recovery status & stop
items.desc: Inspect local loop activity or stop pending recovery work. Character/role XP awards and protection hooks are not active providers in this PS4 build.

items.label: Controller navigation
items.desc: R1 + Square opens or closes the menu. D-pad navigation, X select, Circle back and Square search.

items.label: PS4 keyboard
items.desc: Use controller text entry for search, numeric values and supported file-name fields.

items.label: Themes & colors
items.desc: Choose menu themes and customize interface colors.

items.label: Layout
items.desc: Adjust menu position, scale, section visibility and descriptions.

items.label: Backgrounds
items.desc: Configure supported header/background images and animation settings.

items.label: Configuration profiles
items.desc: Save and load game-specific settings profiles.

items.label: Overlays
items.desc: Configure watermark, FPS, session/pool information and open-menu hints where supported.
